## What Lattices is

Lattices keeps a live model of windows, desktops and terminal sessions, and
lets people and agents act on it through keyboard shortcuts, the `lats` CLI,
the MCP server, or the daemon API.

## Getting started

Install the app and the CLI, tile a window with a key, find and place a
window from the terminal, and start a project session.

## Concepts

lattices is a developer workspace launcher. It creates pre-configured
terminal layouts for your projects, so you can go from
"I want to work on X" to a full development environment in one click.

## Configuration

Place a `.lattices.json` file in your project root to define your
workspace layout. lattices reads this file when creating a session.

## Menu Bar App

The lattices menu bar app is a native macOS companion that lives in your
menu bar and gives you quick access to all your lattices sessions.

## Workspace Layers & Tab Groups

Two ways to organize related projects in `~/.lattices/workspace.json`:

## Daemon API

The lattices menu bar app serves a WebSocket daemon on the private socket
`~/.lattices/run/lattices.sock`. Connections carry the token from
`lattices.token` in the `x-lattices-token` header; `lats` and `daemonCall()`
send it for you. The daemon exposes RPC methods and real-time events for
windows, sessions, layers, terminals and screen text. Everything the app
can do, agents and scripts can do too. Versions before 0.15.1 used
`ws://127.0.0.1:9399`.

## Overview

lattices is a macOS developer workspace manager. It pairs terminal sessions
with a native menu bar app to give you and your AI coding agents
full control over terminal layouts, window tiling, and project navigation.
